name: phd-oce-late-and-short-coursework
description: Policy review round 3, P3-text-ui-3 (2026-10-07): an OCE passed after the eighth semester (entry Fall 2026; semester 8 ends with Spring 2030) with 3 of 24 regular credits at the exam.
